name: @sabaki-js/phishing-detection

modes.mini: cross-encoder MiniLM-L6 ONNX fp32 bundled (1 forward/option, argmax) - latin scripts, model swappable via env SABAKI_PHISHING_DIR

notes: Specialist phishing, latin scripts (de/en/es/fr/id/tr/vi). Held-out: de 0.97 / es 0.99 / id 1.00 / tr 1.00 / vi 0.93 / en 0.85 / fr 0.83. it/pt excluded (weak recall, documented). Accepts 'suspicious' or 'Is this suspicious?'.
